description: Find the errored demo conversation in Agent Observability, read and question its failed generation, open a trace, read one agent's version history in the catalog, read the dependency and workflow graphs, and break the estimated cost chart down by agent and model.

prerequisites.label: A Grafana Cloud stack with Agent Observability enabled.
The one-click demo data seeded on that stack (the Seed the demo data guide).
Optional, for Milestones 3 and 6: an agent of your own sending generations, traces, and metrics to the stack, such as the one from the Connect an agent to Agent Observability path.
